messages:
Incident Bot: 🚨 ALERT: p99 latency breach for customer Stratagem in eu-west-1. Affected: dedicated pool `stratagem-eu1`. p99 = 3.4s, p95 = 930ms. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-latency (severity: high)
Tim O'Neill: I'm on call — paging in. starting triage.
Devon (SRE): seeing elevated backend GPU queue depth + KV cache miss rate spike for that pool. correlates with heavy embedding batch jobs from a single tenant id=tenant-975.
Katya Rivera: opened customer channel with Stratagem support, pinged their SRE. Ask them to hold long-running batch jobs if possible.
Stratagem Support: Thanks — our analytics job kicked off at 09:06 UTC, we can pause within 2–3m. Standby.
Tim O'Neill: Plan: 1) isolate noisy tenant traffic 2) scale pool up 3) route critical traffic to warm-spare (eu-central) 4) apply token-level throttles for non-critical routes. Assigning tasks.
Devon (SRE): I'll run isolation evict + rate-limit on tenant-975 now.
PoolOps Bot: Command queued: `pool isolate-tenant --pool stratagem-eu1 --tenant tenant-975 --duration 30m` — started at 09:11:12 UTC.
Devon (SRE): isolation executed. Confirmed ~60% of noisy requests dropped from pool. p99 dropped to 1.8s within 45s.
Tim O'Neill: Good. Next, scaling.
Jen Ops: Kicking pool scale to add 4 GPUs (hot-add). Command: ```bash
kubectl -n inference exec deploy/pool-operator -- pool scale stratagem-eu1 --gpus +4 --min-ready 2m
```
PoolOps Bot: Scale job enqueued, rolling nodes. ETA ~3m.
Katya Rivera: Notifying account exec + legal (customer SLA note). Stratagem asked for temporary fallback to smaller model for non-authenticated traffic to preserve quota.
Stratagem Support: Confirmed pausing analytics job. We approve fallback on non-critical endpoints.
Devon (SRE): Implemented routing rule: `route-policy stratagem --priority critical->stratagem-eu1, noncritical->stratagem-eu1-small-quant` to move heavy tails to quantized variant.
Tim O'Neill: Also enabling prefix KV priming for critical endpoints to reduce cold misses.
Devon (SRE): Observability: p95 now 420ms, p99 760ms. Warm-spare reroute pending, readiness check failing on one replica (disk pressure). Investigating.
Jen Ops: Working with infra to reprovision the failing replica (clean up local cache). Retrying readiness.
PoolOps Bot: Warm-spare route updated: divert 20% of traffic to eu-central warm-spare pool `stratagem-eu-central-warm`. Healthchecks passing for new nodes.
Tim O'Neill: Customer impact: degraded performance for non-critical requests only; critical endpoints within SLOs. Filing incident note to customer with mitigation steps.
Katya Rivera: Preparing rollback and SLA communication. Also, prep for 1-hour postmortem if stable.
Stratagem Support: Appreciate the quick coordination. We'll monitor on our side.
Devon (SRE): post-mitigation checks: cache hit ratio up 18%, GPU queue depth down to baseline. Continuing to watch.
Tim O'Neill: TL;DR: noisy tenant eviction + pool scale + route to quantized variant + warm-spare diversion = mitigated to p99 < 800ms. Keeping incident open for 30m observation, then handoff to next on-call.
Katya Rivera: Assigning handoff to Devon for 30m watch and then to next-day rotation. Adding notes to incident tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/8523456789
Devon (SRE): Acknowledged. I'll watch for regressions and collect logs for postmortem.
Jen Ops: Created follow-up ticket to review tenant throttling policies and add automated noisy-tenant detection (link: https://redwood.internal/infra/NOISY-TENANT-EPIC).
Incident Bot: NOTE: page suppressed for follow-up. Incident state: mitigated -> watching.
Tim O'Neill: thanks all, great run. :thumbsup:
